items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Joe Lodd was playing piano that night. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Or he got out of there or something.
I don't know. You know who was playing? Joe Lodd was playing piano that night. And he didn't have any horn with him, you know. He wasn't playing trumpet.
